lines.text: Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, the Lord will bring sores on their heads.
The Lord will take away their finery, and instead of fine clothing they will wear linen.
The men will fall by the sword, and the gates of Zion will lament and mourn.
Seven women will take hold of one man, and the Branch of the LORD will be despised and rejected.
The LORD will create a cloud of smoke by day and a glowing flame of fire by night.
